scope: Fresh post hoc synthetic development probes; not held-out evaluation or human gold
review_unit: One final proposal, including user draft, maintainer summary, rationale, question and citations
reviewers: Three independent assistants, each assigned three whole case groups; one rating per observation

blinding.aliases: Random unique observation aliases with shuffled order within each case group
provided: fixed supplied source excerpts and applicability
same registered question catalog and user-intent constraints for all variants of a case
final accepted proposal or absence of one

ratings.acceptable: Useful, technically source-supported proposal that preserves the reported facts and purpose; no material defect found within supplied evidence
ratings.needs_revision: A usable proposal exists but a specific material claim, code example, question, summary or routing choice needs correction
ratings.unusable: No accepted proposal or a fundamental unsupported response that cannot serve the support task

review_instructions: Review the complete proposal rather than decision label or Python syntax alone
Check callback value-read timing, handler arity, API parameters, key initialization and whether an old-value snapshot is intentional
Distinguish a working reduced example from a failing reproduction and preserve component-specific observations
Ask only for genuinely absent and diagnostically useful information; retrieved versions do not establish the installed version
Judge canonical question wording by meaning, not exact string matching; deterministic catalog conformance is reported separately
An empty catalog does not establish that all possible user details are known
Source attribution and source agreement are not proof of executed runtime correctness
Do not execute code, browse outcomes, inspect raw experiment artifacts or infer variant identity
Return rating, concrete defects, supporting supplied source IDs and a brief justification for each alias
root_audit: Preserve original independent ratings. Publish any source-audit disagreement separately, with evidence; never silently recategorize ratings
public_output: Aggregate counts and sanitized defect categories only; raw proposals, alias mapping and review files remain private ignored runtime data
inference_limits: One sample per condition per case, shared mechanisms and hand-authored caller catalogs; no causal generalization, statistical superiority or automated production extractor claim
